title: QuickDASH Outcome Measure
instructions: Rate symptoms and ability in last week from 1 to 5.

items.text: Open a tight or new jar.
Do heavy household chores (e.g., wash walls, floors).
Carry a shopping bag or briefcase.
Use a knife to cut food.
Recreational activities in which you take some force or impact through your arm, shoulder or hand.
Extent arm, shoulder or hand problem interfered with normal social activities.
Limitation in work or other regular daily activities.
Arm, shoulder or hand pain severity.
Tingling (pins and needles) in arm, shoulder or hand.
Difficulty sleeping because of pain in arm, shoulder or hand.
